target.title: fix(feishu): bound streaming card JSON response reads to prevent OOM
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Two response.json() calls in feishu streaming-card.ts read Feishu API responses without a read limit. An oversized response from the Feishu token or create-card endpoints could buffer arbitrarily large payloads before parsing, risking OOM.

## Why This Change Was Made

All external HTTP response reads should use readProviderJsonResponse (16 MiB cap). The file already uses fetchWithSsrFGuard for SSRF protection — this adds memory bounding.

## Evidence

readProviderJsonResponse is tested at packages/media-core/src/read-response-with-limit.test.ts. The change is a pure replacement — same response shape, same error handling.

## Risk

Low. 16 MiB cap is generous for Feishu API responses. Same readProviderJsonResponse helper used across all provider JSON reads.
